name: Katerina
source:
Chairwoman of UHOS Supreme Soviet. She had power over people thanks to the "Red Stone" she wore and so believed she was the humanity's queen.

[spoiler]After she was captured by Japan deeply regrets crimes she did by the influence of Red Stone, although she is just as obstinate as before.

Once she was a orphan and schoolgirl from some village in Russian Kingdom, but that was changed by her finding the Red Stone. Rose the revolution by the banner of "Sharism" (ideolody that Mira Goepe had told her and her friend Milya in one of classes), crushed the Rojio Dynasty and established the UHOS.[/spoiler]

""I want to have this", "I want to have that", "I want to monopolize these". Those thoughts are harmful. For it's those that makes wars begin."
